description: overlapping Notes: a Beat covered by two Notes is judged once, only for the first in the Voice's Note order (its kind and pitch)
comment: Both Notes cover Beat 2. voiceValue = 3 × 1 + 3 × 2 = 9 (each Note counts in full), 1000 × factor per hit Beat. Beat 2 sings G (67), the Golden note's pitch, but is judged against the Normal note on C: d = 700, d' = −500, a miss. Beats 0, 1 hit the Normal note (+1000 each); Beats 3, 4 hit the Golden note (+2000 each).
